_label: EXISTING (read from Figma via Plugin API, read-only)
note: GLASS effects carry radius only: Figma does not expose glass optics (refraction, light) through the Plugin API and they cannot bind variables. Shadow colour binds color/elevation/shadow (Meridian / Colour).
